card.name: Verbs after "no improvement is"
card.fires_on: The word "seen" or "observed" right after phrases like "if no improvement is" or "improvement may be" in dosing instructions. It also fires on "response" in a similar sense.

modes.label: No improvement seen
modes.description: "seen" or "observed" ends a condition about lack of improvement, followed by a time frame.
modes.example: If no improvement is<< seen>> within 2 weeks, reassess diagnosis

modes.label: Improvement may be seen
modes.description: "seen" follows a statement about when benefit may appear.
modes.example: Although improvement may be<< seen>> in a few days in many patients,

modes.label: Response optimization
modes.description: The word "response" appears in the context of dose adjustment for better effect.
modes.example: Consider a dose increase to 125 mg once daily in pediatric patients ≥ 6 years old for<< response>> optimization (clinical/radiological) after
